title: Cubie Wars
description: With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!

title: Dreams in the Capsule
description: Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. Peace and quiet, ardor and flame, despondency and sorrow, every feeling there is settles into a Heart Realm of its own, continuing without end. In this small world, the Court of Savantae and Hsin are shaping the face of Mengzhou anew. This is the Simulacrum Nexus.

title: Past Dreams, Traced Seals
description: Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming, asking you to join her in recording the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. A trip "down memory lane" that draws out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant…

title: Artisan's Search
description: Lisha, apprentice Artisan, reporting for duty!

title: Echo Erase
description: The latest flagship offering from Second Coming of Solaris! Come experience the fun of tapping Echo Pieces away!

title: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
eventName: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
description: During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package.

rewards: from the event page. Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 03:59 (server time)

title: Gifts of Singing Drizzle
description: After the event starts, log in to the game daily to add one day to your cumulative login days. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time. Once your cumulative login days meet the requirement, the corresponding cumulative login reward will be ready to claim.

title: Waking Moon Fishing
description: The Waking Moon Festival is underway. Lights shine everywhere. Then a mysterious stall appears right in front of you... Participate in the fishing challenge and unlock entries in the Fishing Index to win Astrites! And complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.

title: Back to Solaris
description: Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts! With code linking rewards available for Returning Players!
rewards: available for Returning Players! Duration: Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 23:59 (UTC+8)

title: Blooms for the Shadow
description: Looming over the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, the Nexus Fox Shadow watches the realm with cold detachment. Everything within the Heart Realms is born of Hsin's heart, and shifts as it does. This towering shadow, a manifestation of the heart, is bound up in that same interplay, shaping and shaped by the Heart Realms in turn. However, a conversation with a Celestial from the Court of Savantae has revealed something new: the Fox Shadow reacts to a specific token within the Simulacrum Nexus...

title: Event Preview | [Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis] Combat Event, Coming Soon!
description: Astrite x1200, Space and Blake Bloom Medal (Event Sigil), Space and Blake Bloom (Event Avatar), Modifier, Premium Tuner, Forgery Premium Supply - Lahai-Roi, Premium Enclosure Tank - Land of Xuanfang, Shell Credit, and other materials.

title: Moonlit Path
description: Here is detailed info about the limited-time event "Moonlit Path" and merchandise in the Store in Version 3.7. Don't miss out!

title: V3.7 Wuthering Waves Battle Rush
description: The Wuthering Waves Battle Rush is now live! Record and share your most exciting battle moments with the hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle on X (Twitter)/YouTube Shorts/TikTok to compete for a reward of Astrite x2,000 and a chance to get featured on our social media with direct credits! Other than these rewards, 10 extra winners will be selected to receive a $50 Amazon Gift Card. Showcase your outstanding battle tactics in a condensed clip and share them with us!

title: Wuthering Waves Fan Creation Event "Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination" is now live!
eventName: Wuthering Waves Fan Creation Event "Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination" is now live!
description: Wuthering Waves Fan Creation Event "Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination" is now live! Post your work with hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuWaFanart on X (Twitter)/Instagram/Facebook and fill out the form for a chance to win iPhone 18 Pro 512GB, Astrites and more! Create your works of boundless imagination to present the world of Wuthering Waves!

title: Night City Roaming
description: This is a place where dreams overlap with reality, where violence and conflict keep fortunes flowing. Here, everything is up for grabs, provided you can pay the price. Welcome to Night City.

title: Instant Flashlight
description: During the collab version, you may claim 5-Star Resonator Rebecca for free via this event.

title: Gifts of Dreamchasers
description: This event's login rewards are split into regular login rewards and cumulative login rewards.

title: Matrix Reform
description: As frequencies spill forth from the Somnoire, Lucy seeks your assistance in breaching the dreamscape to contain the problem. The "Sweetdream Tuning" event will be simultaneously available alongside Collab Resonator/Weapon Convene of the "At Dream's Edge" collab campaign. When the number of Convene attempts reaches specific milestones, corresponding rewards will become available.

title: Startorch Racing, Rerun!
description: Startorch Racing is back! This time, it's not just a race against the clock. You're going head-to-head against other players. Hop on your expedition motorbike and throttle toward the finish line!

description: During the event, log in to claim the day's login rewards from the event page.

title: Cubie Derby: Championship
description: A new season of Cubie Derby is back for the 2nd Anniversary of the Second Coming of Solaris! Come watch the match and support your Cube!

title: Aced! Combat Mastery Test!
description: Standard tests make your eyes glaze over, but a test of combat skills sends your adrenaline into overdrive. So bring your A-game and step into the clash for Instructor B.1.N.G.O.'s Combat Mastery Test!

title: Lollo Express: Promise Delivered
description: For the couriers of Lollo Logistics, no hardship is too great, no obstacle too steep. Their resolve to deliver never wavers. As the collab season between Second Coming of Solaris and Lollo Logistics takes flight, their most demanding rush has begun...

title: Star Bouncing
description: Guided by the orbit, led by luck, and fueled by romanticism. This is the great adventure—a vibrant trek across the galaxy. Time to let the sea of stars bounce in rhythm with your heart!

title: Back to Solaris
description: Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts! "Resident Evil 30th Anniversary," "Angry Birds," and "Kaiju No. 8" Collab Event. Complete tasks in the Collab Event to obtain the corresponding Collab Livery and various levelling Materials.

title: Dimmr Traces
description: Beneath Lahai-Roi, the Solvein Heartwood towers overhead, as though holding up those long, shadowed ages. Innumerable motes drift here like traces of a past not yet extinguished, ancient and silent, waiting for an answer. Follow the light downward, and amid layers of dust, listen as those bygone days begin to wake.

title: The Flaming Red in Memory
description: Platya, a Black Shores Bloom Bearer, has come to Startorch Academy chasing rumors of a Ghost Miko—whispers that seem to echo the legend of the "Lady Miko" of her distant homeland. Intrigued, you join her search.
